units: Pes. 61ᵃ (expl. תכסו, Ex. XII, 4) טלה זה לשון סורסי הוא … כוס לו it is an abbreviated form (v. סוּרְסִי), as one says to his neighbor, kos (for נְכוֹס) &c., cut this lamb for me; Y. ib. V, 32ᵃ bot.; Mekh. Bo. s. 3.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 82b:9">Snh. 82ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>כזבי</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 25:15">Num. XXV, 15</cite>) <he>שאמרה לאביה כוס בי עם זה</he> she said to her father, cut (ruin) this people through me.

<cite ref="Chullin 37b:6">Ḥull. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>בְּשַׂר כוס כוס</he> meat of an animal about which one says, ‘cut, cut’, i.e. meat of an animal hurriedly cut, because it threatens to die; Treat. Kuthim (ed. Kirchh., p. 33, sq.) we must not sell to Samaritans <cite ref="K00326"><he>כּוֹסְכּוֹס</he></cite> (sub. <he>בשר</he>) meat of an animal on the point of death.
